description: This file defines the class BuzzShareDecorator, which is a decorator for the BuzzShare entity within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods to modify interaction counts and associate employees with BuzzShare instances, indicating its role in augmenting business logic related to 'buzz shares' or social media-like features.

classes.name: BuzzShareDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds additional functionality to the BuzzShare entity, including managing employee associations and modifying comment and like counts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a specific BuzzShare entity.

methods.name: getBuzzShare
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the wrapped BuzzShare entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee to the BuzzShare by their employee number.

methods.name: increaseNumOfCommentsByOne
methods.description: Increments the number of comments on the BuzzShare entity.

methods.name: decreaseNumOfCommentsByOne
methods.description: Decrements the number of comments on the BuzzShare entity.

methods.name: increaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Increments the number of likes on the BuzzShare entity.

methods.description: Decrements the number of likes on the BuzzShare entity.
